trigger_all_required: own reasoning is a nonempty string
scribe_contract.trigger_exclusions: No commit after transport failure, ordinary stop, empty reasoning or a non-None parsed plan, even if that plan is malformed/illegal. Nonempty invalidJSON may qualify if the parser returnsNone and all other predicates hold. Do not substitute content truthiness or verifier-success tests.
scribe_contract.notes_lineage: Only this case first request own notes; no extraction/correction, old traces, other agents/cases, witnesses or stronger-model task answers. Same commit instruction/task across all three note arms; only selected notes differ.
scribe_contract.budget_outcomes: No eligible call may exceed the remaining case ceiling/deadline. Log denials and deadline outcomes without fabricating a valid result or extra attempt; classify infrastructure from positive transport/controller evidence, not from a denial count alone.

unchanged_rules.verifier: Frozen exact-rational apply_action/solved semantics, integer-only positive intermediates; target may occur anywhere, leftovers allowed, at most n-1 moves. No changes to original acceptance.
unchanged_rules.explicit_semantics: State that remaining numbers need not be consumed; stop as soon as target appears; ordered operands mean state[i] op state[j] (or a op b), including subtraction/division; indices are reindexed after each move.
unchanged_rules.value_compiler: Require exact {a,b,op} schema, type(a)==type(b)==int (bool/float rejected), valid one-character operator. Consume leftmost available occurrence of a, then leftmost distinct occurrence of b; pass those indices and original ordered op to unchanged apply_action. Reject unavailable values/duplicates; no operand swap or corrective search.
unchanged_rules.single_prompt_control: Original-index arm preserves original prompt; value arms change only address representation/schema, explicit arms add the same existing-semantics clarification. Prompt/body templates must be source-pinned before calls.

scheduling.admission: One whole case per node, four independent existing Nemo replicas. No simultaneous cases on one node; no other model workload. This is recipe profiling, not a throughput/saturation study.
scheduling.block_order: Seeds1,2,3 outermost; for each seed, the8development tasks in their stored order (4/6alternating). Block b=8*seed_index+task_index,0..23.
scheduling.variant_order: Within each block, position j=0..6 runs variants[(j+floor(b/4)) mod7]. Rotation changes every4blocks to balance each variant across hosts.
scheduling.node_assignment: node=1+((7*b+j) mod4). Each node serializes its own block jobs; complete/drain admitted cases before next global block. After an operational fault, set a shared stop flag and schedule no further execute() calls; cases whose execution already started may finish their fixed policy/cleanup. No subsequent block is admitted.
scheduling.balance: 42cases/node total; each variant has2cases/node/seed (6/node overall). No adaptive admission, outcome-based reordering, retries or dropped failures.
scheduling.canonical_schedule_serialization: UTF8 json.dumps(schedule_rows, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon)); row fields listed below; nodes are1-based

reporting_and_decision.primary: Verified successes/24 for every variant, paired on the same8task×3seed labels. Always retain all candidate failures and controlled task-budget exhaustions. Real transport/source/controller failures preserve incomplete evidence and stop the cohort for review.
secondary: eligible commit count and conditional exact-proof conversion, with denominators
whole-case latency/deadlines and actual completed/unfinished requests
client input/completion usage separately; unknown/missing usage retained as unknown/lower bounds
idle-delimited server input/output counters including canceled work/drain, coverage stated; no zero substitution
reporting_and_decision.adoption_rule: Require a complete independently audited168-case cohort. Prefer a variant only if it strictly improves verified development successes over index_original. Rank by solved count descending; ties use lower servercompletion total ONLY if all7arms have24/24complete known servercosts, then lower clientinput total ONLY if all7havecomplete inputusage; otherwise skip that cost tier. Final tie uses the listed variant order. If none strictly improves, retain baseline and report negative development results; any new search needs another prospective amendment.
reporting_and_decision.selection_limits: Small8-task development selection is exploratory and winner-biased; no quality conclusion from finish rates alone or a zero-denial gate. Common caps are not matched actual cost. Freeze selected recipe/primary contrast before any fresh evaluation.
